text:
Hannah P: quick report from porting the realtime demo: Go Generator streams don't abort promptly when ctx is cancelled. hitting goroutine pileup.
Ibrahim S: can you paste the minimal repro?
Hannah P: small snippet from the example app:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
stream, _ := client.Generator("realtime").Stream(ctx, prompt)
go func() {
  for {
    t, err := stream.Recv()
    if err != nil { log.Printf("recv err: %v", err); return }
    fmt.Print(t.Text)
  }
}()
// user navigates away -> cancel()
cancel() // goroutine hangs on Recv() until TCP read times out
```
Hannah P: repeated open/close -> hundreds of goroutines. memory climbs.
Jules M: that sounds like the transport Read() blocks and never observes ctx.Done(). We added a cancelable reader in JS earlier; go hasn't had it. Also note the retry middleware will retry on 401/5xx and will replay streaming requests which can produce duplicate partial tokens when an auth refresh happens mid-stream.
Ibrahim S: proposed fixes: 1) implement a cancelable io.Reader wrapper that unblocks Read on ctx cancel, 2) disable automatic retries for streaming endpoints (or make opt-in), 3) improve ergonomics by adding RecvWith(ctx, timeout) or a StreamController with Start/Close so callers can manage lifecycle explicitly.
Hannah P: RecvWith would be nice for backpressure control and clearer onboarding examples. current quickstart only shows a naive loop.
Jules M: API sketch suggestion:
```go
sc := client.Generator("x").BuildStream(prompt)
_ = sc.Start(ctx)
for {
  tok, err := sc.RecvWith(ctx, time.Second*2)
  if err == context.DeadlineExceeded { continue }
  if err != nil { break }
  fmt.Print(tok.Text)
}
sc.Close()
```
Ibrahim S: also add example at examples/go/streaming/cancel-demo and tests that assert no goroutine leak after cancel and that duplicates from token refresh are not merged.
Hannah P: I'll open an issue with logs and a tiny harness and add the sample PR once we have an API.
dev-bot: issue created by Hannah P (#611) "go sdk stream cancel + ergonomics" and assigned to Ibrahim S; label "devex" added.
Ibrahim S: I'll prototype the cancelable reader and WithNoRetry flag, add RecvWith and the sample. ETA 72h.
Jules M: once PR lands we'll update the Go quickstart and add a short note in CHANGELOG about streaming semantics and recommended cancel patterns so parity with JS/Python is clear.
Hannah P: thanks — that will help onboarding a lot. I'll comment on the issue with the repro path: examples/go/realtime/cancel-harness. :thumbsup:
